description: Boundary coverage for the opt-out enable-marker selector. Adds the omitted-marker case (no marker object at all), which counts as absent and is therefore admitted, alongside a mixed batch covering present-true (admit), present-false (reject, the only rejection path), explicitly-absent (admit) and omitted (admit) in a single input-ordered run. Output lists each candidate as its name and whether it was admitted.

cases.expected_output:
container=pt included=true
container=pf included=false
container=absent included=true
container=omitted included=true
